args.title: Handle amounts without leading zeros in parseAmount
args.body:
File: src/util/money.ts

Modify the regular expression or introduce preprocessing in the parseAmount function to handle amounts such as .75 or -.75, which currently fail due to starting with a decimal point. This ensures amounts common in bank exports are parsed correctly.

label: bug
file: src/util/money.ts
This comment was written by RepoMind, an automated triage agent. To reach a person, mention @ledgerline/maintainers.

The `parseAmount` function does not handle amounts starting with a decimal point, such as .75 or -.75. The regular expression or preprocessing should be modified to correctly parse these common amount formats in bank exports.
